stock.description: ArtGo Holdings Limited, an investment holding firm founded in 2009 and based in Shanghai, People's Republic of China, primarily engages in the extraction, refinement, and commercialization of marble stones, alongside commodity trading operations throughout China. The company's business is structured into two main divisions: Marble Products and Others. Within its Marble Products segment, ArtGo offers a diverse portfolio including marble slabs, custom-cut marble, antique-style series, intricate water jet designs, decorative border elements, and bespoke marble handicrafts for various household uses, particularly bathrooms. It also manufactures calcium carbonate products. Beyond its core marble offerings, the company provides cargo management services and is involved in the wholesale and retail distribution of decorative items and chemical substances. Its additional activities include offering technical expertise for stone processing, overseeing warehousing and logistics for mineral product sales, and participating in mining investment and development ventures. The company officially changed its name from ArtGo Mining Holdings Limited to its current designation in March 2015.
